hero.sub: Paste a GitHub repo. Get one plain report on security, testing, quality and legal risk.
how.title: One link in. One clear answer out.
how.1.title: Paste your repository
how.1.body: A public GitHub link is enough. We read the code and never run it.
how.2.title: We check four things
how.2.body: Secrets and weak spots, tests, code quality, and what you collect from users.
how.3.title: Fix with a copy-paste prompt
how.3.body: Every finding comes with a plain explanation and a prompt for Cursor or Claude Code.
bento.security.title: Security
bento.security.body: Keys left in the code, risky packages, and databases anyone can read.
bento.testing.title: Testing
bento.testing.body: Whether the parts that matter have tests at all.
bento.quality.title: Code quality
bento.quality.body: The habits that make an app hard to change later.
bento.legal.title: Legal and privacy
bento.legal.body: Privacy policy, tracking, and user data, checked against the regions you choose. Findings to review, not legal advice.
faq.title: Questions
faq.1.a: No. We download a copy, read it, and delete it when the scan ends.
faq.2.q: Is the legal check legal advice?
faq.2.a: No. Legal results are findings to review. Ask a professional before you rely on them.
faq.3.a: A few scans a day are free. A project pass unlocks every explanation and fix prompt for one repository.
faq.4.q: Can I scan a private repository?
faq.4.a: Not yet. For now we scan public GitHub repositories.
footer.disclaimer: Automated findings. Review anything legal with a professional.
report.fixLabel: Fix prompt for Cursor or Claude Code
report.incomplete.title: Some checks could not finish
report.incomplete.body: A report with a gap cannot be signed off. Run the scan again, or check the list below.
report.locked.title: Details are part of a project pass
report.locked.body: You can see what is wrong and where. The explanation and the fix prompt unlock with a pass for this repository.
report.lockedBanner: {count} findings show only a title and a location. A project pass unlocks them all.
report.lockedBanner.one: 1 finding shows only a title and a location. A project pass unlocks it.

pricing.title: Pay once for the repo you are fixing.
pricing.free.title: Free
pricing.free.body: A few scans a day. Every finding shows its title and where it is. The two most important ones come with the full explanation and fix prompt.
pricing.pass.title: Project pass
pricing.pass.body: One repository for {days} days. Scan again as often as you like until it is signed off. Every explanation and fix prompt is unlocked.
pricing.pass.points: Unlimited rescans of that repository|Every explanation and fix prompt|Legal checks for your regions

checkout.after: After you pay, we approve it by hand and your pass starts. Write the reference in the payment note.
